summary: Iteration 2 tested the new admin panel (JWT auth + protected workshop CRUD). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (login OK, wrong-password 401, wrong-email 401, /auth/me with token, without token 401, invalid-token 401, protected POST/PUT/DELETE 401 without token, full create→GET→update→GET→delete→404 with token, plus non-existent update 404). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Info tab shows 'Administración' row → opens admin-login-screen; wrong password shows inline error; correct creds navigate to admin-dashboard (12 workshops with admin-edit/admin-delete/admin-add FAB). 'Nuevo taller' → admin-form → filled f-name/f-cat-frenos/f-address/f-comuna/f-phone/f-image → form-save → returned to dashboard now with 13 items (created workshop VISIBLE). Edit opens form with prefilled fields → save persists new name. Delete shows inline confirm (admin-delete-confirm-{id}) → row removed. admin-logout clears session (subsequent tap on Administración row re-shows the login screen).

issues: Deprecation warnings still present on RN Web console: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking — carried over from iteration 1.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' StyleSheet props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents (unchanged from iteration 1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hashes admin password with bcrypt (cost 12) and uses a DUMMY_HASH to equalize timing for missing accounts — good.
Idempotent admin seed with unique index on admins.email — safe on restart.
JWT secret / algorithm / TTL loaded from env (no hardcoding). Token stored in expo-secure-store under 'va_admin_token'.
authFetch on frontend clears token on 401 and shows 'Sesión expirada' — good UX.
Workshop CRUD endpoints correctly project _id out on read/update.
isLoggedIn() calls /api/auth/me on every access — could be cached briefly but acceptable.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_auth.py (new pytest suite for admin auth + CRUD)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login-error, login-success, list, create, edit, delete-with-confirm, logout, session-clear)
